coherent_choices: One new bootstrap-successor owner/Origin/nonce/registry starts the future synthetic cohort; no legacy object upgrade or numeric restart.
Ports and controller are non-owning views; old run_once, owner constructors, independent finally/cleanup and repeated output reservation are excluded.
EarlySourceContext and loader retain exact immutable early bytes and current live slot provenance; EvidenceContext unions remaining captures without early reopen/rehash.
Raw first facts, field watermarks, immutable diagnostics, once-only close and original primary/known late facts are copied as algorithms requiring new actual-method regressions.
One original295/300 clock and one event ledger; terminal candidate/cleanup/tip/receipt/seal/final acknowledgment order and no posthard sink calls remain explicit.
Pure-seam consistent/negative outcomes keep all real-source/checker/FFI/runtime/profile flags false; the old timed-out experiment is neither repaired nor replayed.

material_blockers.basis: FilePortView activates only seven original-file APIs and the fictional sink returns acknowledgments, while late_count/budget cases mention WriteFile/short writes and terminal order claims write/flush/close observations.
material_blockers.required_closure: Declare exactly which first-batch effects are modeled. Prefer keep the seven-API original subset and label sink acknowledgments as abstract fictional publication outcomes, with no raw write-count/flush/physical-close evidence. Restrict the first fixtures accordingly; actual WriteFile/physical sink remains a later explicit gate. Do not infer namespace ownership or physical completion from an acknowledgment outside its declared synthetic contract.

material_blockers.basis: R can reach68 and the proposal retains failed/unknown/pending generations under an aggregate131072-byte raw-buffer ceiling, but does not bound allocation/reuse across those generations and identity frames.
material_blockers.required_closure: Specify finite preallocated frame capacities/counts, serial allocation/reuse eligibility, release/retention rules, and a stop rule preventing fresh work after a retained failed/unknown generation. Joint admission must account for all retained identity/read frames and separately bounded immutable captures. Enforce the aggregate before allocating; merely bounding generation count byR does not prove fit.

material_blockers.basis: publish(kind,...) says closed eight nonjournal kinds, but those kind names and exact publication/once rules are absent.
material_blockers.required_closure: Enumerate the eight fixed names, per-kind once/byte limits, reservation/journal membership and failure/late/afterseal behavior. Define candidate/cleanup/journal-tip/receipt/seal dependencies and source-issued acknowledgment binding. Terminal artifacts after journal close must remain registry-only and may never reopen that journal.

material_blockers.basis: The proposal requires joint admission before original opens, but its early entry takes only early specs; the full request/authority is introduced later in match_full_roster/continue_once.
material_blockers.required_closure: Provide the immutable provisional full descriptor/early/module plan and joint ceilings before the first early open, with lexical role/alias/size/capture and derived-budget rejection then. Later authority may corroborate or reject that exact admitted request; it must not silently expand/reset it. Keep delayed semantic authority separate from early bounded resource admission.

material_blockers.basis: The frozen209-byte cohort exposes only marker()/run(), while continuation accepts authority_factory/checker_factory and describes source binding.
material_blockers.required_closure: Choose explicit trusted fixture-only branded injected authority/checker handlers for this first cohort, with real factory/source/checker binding pending, while testing the captured marker-chain loader separately. Specify their owner/Origin/context identity and lifecycle/signatures. Do not mutate the cohort/add factory source or let arbitrary callbacks/ready dictionaries assert source binding. Clarify synthetic mode success versus refused real-checker mode.

next_gate: Retain this exact proposal; separately version only these finite design closures for peer/root review. Concrete synthetic schedules then precede separately authorized source implementation. No broader framework or real binding expansion is requested.
scope: Independent design-only interface/arithmetic/causal review of the exact proposed three-source integration. No new integration implementation, fixture schedule, reviewed-helper import or runtime execution.
